<thought>The molecular formula derived from the SMILES matches the observed mass (C16H16O, m/z 224.12). The carbonyl carbon at ~197 ppm, two aliphatic CH₂ signals (~36–38 ppm), a methyl carbon (~26 ppm), and the aromatic carbon pattern correspond to a phenyl‑acetyl‑phenyl structure with a para‑methyl substituent. The ¹H NMR integration (3 H singlet, two 2 H triplets, aromatic protons) is consistent with this structure. Therefore the SMILES that fits all data is:</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)CCc2ccc(cc2)C</final_answer>
